mission.title: Defuse the Situation
mission.description: Disable the Colonel's explosive device before it destroys the bluepill pods.

phase.briefing:
The threat posed by the Colonel's explosive device is completely unacceptable. Since your last mission, we have obtained data that may allow us to disable the device.
Proceed to the indicated location and locate an encrypted access code.

enter.say: That code should be on site here somewhere.

done.say: Bingo! Head out of there and we'll get our next waypoint.

phase.briefing:
Excellent work, {player}. The data on that CD must be decrypted before we can use it.
Proceed to our data lab and submit the CD for decryption.

enter.say: Okay, there should be a decryption terminal in here. Just put the CD in and the Machine programs will do the rest for us.

objective.text: Put the CD in the decryption terminal

done.say: All set! Now off to use the disk.

phase.briefing:
Now comes the most... delicate part of this mission, {player}. You must take the decrypted CD to a nearby transmitting station. Place the CD in the transmitting computer there, and activate a nearby targeting system.
The system must transmit the signal for a certain period of time. Needless to say, the Colonel's minions will surely do what they can to... interfere with our plans. Be prepared.

enter.say: There should be a room in here with two computers. Put the CD into one of the computers, and then activate the second one, and then... get ready.
I'm reading inbound signals! Heads up!

objective.text: Place the CD in the transmitting computer

complete.say:
Very good, {player}. The explosive device has been disabled.
Your cooperation has proved invaluable.

There's one thing Gray didn't explain... who in the world would have the kind of access and resources to pose this sort of threat?
I don't have a good feeling about this, {player}.
